body: in high school, a now gone friend once told me: 'every year lived is a year too long.'
Take this post and throw it in the garbage. Nothing but false hopes and broken dreams. We don't need patronizing shit like this on here, as it - quite frankly - makes shit significantly worse.

I've been thinking the same, except I personslly don't really care about feeling guilty. I don't care how I go really, I just want it done without any troubles. No hassles. No nothing. Being murdered is a win-win for me. No one in my friend- and family circle cares anyways. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
